bounded_host_request.command:
set -eu
cid=gace-createvdobot-videobot-poll-1
root=/home/gace/.local/share/gace-create-videobot/native-sticker-c8c50d420c0b9b5d447a1fc87ef3d9e1ec7aceed/deploy
compose="$root/compose.videobot.poll.yaml"
test "$(docker inspect "$cid" --format '{{.State.Running}}')" = true
new_id="$(docker image inspect create-videobot:video-sale-1695 --format '{{.Id}}')"
old_id="$(docker inspect "$cid" --format '{{.Image}}')"
test "$new_id" != "$old_id"
verified="$(docker exec deploy-postgres-1 sh -c 'psql -X -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -U "$POSTGRES_USER" -d "$POSTGRES_DB" -Atc "select count(*) from posting_topics where purpose='\''video_sale'\'' and board_key='\''video_chat'\'' and chat_id=-1002373696859 and message_thread_id=1695 and enabled and verified_by is not null and verified_at is not null;"')"
test "$verified" = 1 || exit 61
docker run --rm --network none --entrypoint node create-videobot:video-sale-1695 --input-type=module -e '
import{createTelegramBotApi}from"./src/telegram/botApi.mjs";
const t="123:"+("A".repeat(32));
const f=async()=>({status:200,json:async()=>({ok:true,result:{id:123}})});
const a=createTelegramBotApi({token:t,fetchImpl:f});
await a("getChat",{chat_id:-1002373696859});
await a("getChatMember",{chat_id:-1002373696859,user_id:123});
' >/dev/null
backup="$compose.video-sale-1695.backup"
test ! -e "$backup"
cp -p "$compose" "$backup"
restore(){ cp -p "$backup" "$compose"; (cd "$root" && docker compose -f "$compose" up -d --no-deps --no-build --force-recreate videobot-poll) >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; }
trap restore EXIT
python3 - "$compose" <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
import sys,re
p=Path(sys.argv[1]);lines=p.read_text().splitlines(keepends=True)
start=next((i for i,x in enumerate(lines) if re.match(r'^  videobot-poll:\s*$',x.rstrip())),None)
if start is None:raise SystemExit('SERVICE_MISSING')
end=next((i for i in range(start+1,len(lines)) if re.match(r'^  [\w-]+:\s*$',lines[i].rstrip())),len(lines))
s=lines[start:end]
if any('VIDEOBOT_VIDEO_SALE_THREAD_ID' in x or 'VIDEOBOT_VIDEO_SALE_TOPIC_TITLE' in x for x in s):raise SystemExit('ENV_ALREADY_SET_RECONCILE')
image=next((i for i in range(start+1,end) if re.match(r'^    image:\s*',lines[i])),None)
if image is None or 'create-videobot:local-poll' not in lines[image]:raise SystemExit('IMAGE_BASELINE_UNEXPECTED')
lines[image]=re.sub(r'create-videobot:local-poll','create-videobot:video-sale-1695',lines[image])
env=next((i for i in range(start+1,end) if re.match(r'^    environment:\s*$',lines[i].rstrip())),None)
if env is None:raise SystemExit('ENV_BLOCK_MISSING')
following=next((x for x in lines[env+1:end] if x.strip() and not x.lstrip().startswith('#')),None)
if following is None:raise SystemExit('ENV_STYLE_UNKNOWN')
if following.startswith('      - '):
 add=['      - VIDEOBOT_VIDEO_SALE_THREAD_ID=1695\n','      - VIDEOBOT_VIDEO_SALE_TOPIC_TITLE=💰️稼げる有料動画投稿\n']
elif re.match(r'^      [A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*:',following):
 add=['      VIDEOBOT_VIDEO_SALE_THREAD_ID: "1695"\n','      VIDEOBOT_VIDEO_SALE_TOPIC_TITLE: "💰️稼げる有料動画投稿"\n']
else:raise SystemExit('ENV_STYLE_UNSUPPORTED')
lines[env+1:env+1]=add
p.write_text(''.join(lines))
PY
(cd "$root" && docker compose -f "$compose" config --quiet)
(cd "$root" && docker compose -f "$compose" up -d --no-deps --no-build --force-recreate videobot-poll) >/dev/null
test "$(docker inspect "$cid" --format '{{.State.Running}}')" = true
test "$(docker inspect "$cid" --format '{{.Image}}')" = "$new_id"
docker exec "$cid" node -e 'if(process.env.VIDEOBOT_VIDEO_SALE_THREAD_ID!=="1695"||!process.env.VIDEOBOT_VIDEO_SALE_TOPIC_TITLE?.includes("稼げる有料動画投稿"))process.exit(75)'
docker exec "$cid" node --input-type=module -e 'import{configuredVideoSaleTopic}from"./owner/gateOwner.mjs";if(configuredVideoSaleTopic().threadId!==1695)process.exit(76)'
for i in 1 2 3 4 5 6 7 8;do
 if docker logs "$cid" --tail 130 2>&1 | grep -q 'CREATOR_DM_POLL_READY=PASS';then break;fi
 sleep 2
done
docker logs "$cid" --tail 130 2>&1 | grep -q 'CREATOR_DM_POLL_READY=PASS'
trap - EXIT
echo VIDEO_SALE_DEPLOY_RUNTIME=PASS
echo VIDEO_SALE_TOPIC=1695
